name: KTM
note: Partner on Red Bull KTM Tech3's official site (logo links to ktm.com); KTM AG also builds the team's RC16. Left unrated: KTM is a brand of the Bajaj Mobility group, about 74.9% owned by an indirect subsidiary of Bajaj Auto Ltd, India (ktm-bajaj-ownership), but Bajaj Auto's own shareholders aren't sourced, so a state holding of 5% or more further up can't be ruled out.
